thread:
Alex: Quick sync — collecting final remediation owners/timelines for regional resilience before the next playbook drill. I updated the tracker; please confirm owners and realistic ETAs.
Maria: Thanks Alex. Pulled a short list from the postmortem: 
  1) Multi-region routing fallback policy - owner: Maria - ETA: 2026-04-10 - verify canary + auto-failover
  2) Backup verification + restore runbook - owner: Emily - ETA: 2026-04-07 - include end-to-end restore test
  3) KV cache cold-start mitigation (warmup priming) - owner: Raj - ETA: 2026-04-14 - add metrics to dashboard
  4) Dedicated test capacity for game days - owner: Matt - ETA: 2026-04-05 - request reserved nodes for 6h windows

  Quick snippet for the restore runbook I drafted:
  ```
  # restore-check.sh (pseudo)
  export REGION=eu-west
  snapshot_id=$(gcs ls backups/${REGION} | tail -n1)
  restore --from $snapshot_id --target test-restore-cluster
  wait_for_service healthy --timeout 1800
  run smoke-tests --suite restore
  ```

Matt: For routing fallback, do we want to test weighted routing or full region cutover for the game day? Weighted seems lower risk. :thinking:
Maria: Weighted canary first, yes. We need a rollback plan if latency spikes. I'll add a canary checklist to the playbook.
Emily: I can own the restore runbook and run the first full restore in a dry-run on 2026-04-07. Need a slot for reserved test capacity though. I'll also capture RTO/RPO numbers. :thumbsup:
Raj: Recurring pattern note: our recent incidents show a correlation between peak KV cache churn and increased tail latency in eu-west. Recommend adding an alert on sustained cache miss rate > 15% for 3m and a dashboard panel for rolling miss-rate. Owner: Raj (same ETA).
SRE Bot: Reminder set: "restore-dryrun" scheduled for 2026-04-07 09:00 UTC. Participants: Emily, Matt. :calendar:
Alex: Great — please update the tracker with the exact calendar invites and include required infra (reserved nodes, snapshot retention window). Link I used: https://redwood-internal/sheets/regional-resilience-tracker (add write perms if needed).
Maria: Small dependency: the canary automation needs the new routing policy schema merged. PR #2345 is pending review. @Matt can you prioritize?
Matt: On it. I'll review this afternoon and queue a canary rollout during the 04-05 maintenance slot if all good.
Emily: Confirming I'll run the restore dry-run and upload logs + a short howto doc to the playbook page after the test.
Raj: I'll add the KV cache alert and a graph to the console dashboard. Will also create a short runbook blurb for mitigation steps (cache warmup + gradual drain).
Alex: Owners confirmed — Maria, Emily, Raj, Matt. ETA summary: 04-05 to 04-14 depending on item. Action: everyone add sprints/tickets and link them in the tracker. I'll follow up in two days to check progress. :eyes:
SRE Bot: Incident tracker updated: fields modified by Maria, Raj.
Maria: Filing the tickets now. ETA for ticket creation: 30m.
Matt: Can we block 6h of dedicated test capacity for 2026-04-07 08:00-14:00 UTC? I'll open the request after PR review.
Emily: Sounds good. If anyone wants to join the restore run, ping me. I'll post run details in #eng-oncall the day before.
Alex: Thanks team — let's aim to close ownership and tickets by end-of-day tomorrow. We'll use the game-day drill to validate these. Closing notes: keep threads short and link tickets, not long replies here. :white_check_mark:
